description: This file contains shell script functions for configuring and managing DHCPv6 network protocols, including initialization, setup, renewal, and teardown procedures. It defines configuration parameters, helper functions, and protocol-specific commands used in network interface configuration scripts.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes DHCPv6 configuration parameters with default values and possible options.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_prefix
methods.description: Appends a DHCPv6 prefix to a list.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_sendopts
methods.description: Adds send options to the DHCPv6 command line if provided.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_setup
methods.description: Sets up DHCPv6 with specified configuration for a network interface, preparing options and environment variables, and then executes the DHCPv6 client.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_renew
methods.description: Sends a signal to renew the DHCPv6 lease for a specified interface.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_teardown
methods.description: Kills DHCPv6 client process for a specified interface, effectively tearing down the DHCPv6 configuration.
